lines.zh: 骨锤拖过地面，犁出一道沟。
lines.en: The bone hammer drags a furrow in the ground.

lines.zh: 每一步都让骨甲嗡地一响。
lines.en: Each step makes its bone armor hum.
Stand and gaze at nothing
Bone plates tremble slightly

lines.zh: 这把骨锤就是我的手臂。
lines.en: This bone hammer is my arm.
Scan for enemies

lines.zh: 我一口气一口气地喘着。
lines.en: I breathe one heavy breath at a time.
Bone hammer taps lightly
Stare in silence
Bone armor slightly vibrates
Mutter to self

lines.zh: 我扛着骨锤，望向远处的雾。
lines.en: I shoulder my bone hammer and stare into the mist.

lines.zh: 把骨锤立在地上当拐杖。
lines.en: It rests the bone hammer like a cane.

lines.zh: 挡甲下的胸腔一起一伏。
lines.en: The chest beneath the bone plate swells and sinks.

lines.zh: 它抬手抹掉锤上的碎渣。
lines.en: It wipes debris off the hammer head.

lines.zh: 厚骨甲上有几道旧裂痕。
lines.en: Old cracks run through the thick bone plate.

lines.zh: 它原地转了半圈，嗅了嗅。
lines.en: It turns halfway and sniffs the air.

lines.zh: 召唤它的低语已经散了。
lines.en: The whisper that called it has faded.
I lower my head, eyes never leaving you.
Bone hammer points at player
Bone hammer dragging, my eyes on you.

lines.zh: 骨锤落下来之前，会先响一声。
lines.en: My bone hammer rings once before it falls.

lines.zh: 骨甲缝里透出我的目光。
lines.en: My gaze leaks through the seams of my bone armor.
My eye does not move at all.
Beneath thick bone plate, I stare at you.

lines.zh: 我这把骨锤，比我人还重。
lines.en: My bone hammer weighs more than I do.

lines.zh: 骨锤抬起来，你就在视野里。
lines.en: Bone hammer raised, you're in my sight.

lines.zh: 我的骨锤正对着你的头。
lines.en: My bone hammer is level with your head.

lines.zh: 骨甲缝隙里透出两点光。
lines.en: Two points of light shine through the bone gaps.

lines.zh: 它慢慢抬起锤头对着你。
lines.en: It slowly raises the hammer head at you.

lines.zh: 它打量你的身板，摇了摇头。
lines.en: It sizes you up and shakes its head.

lines.zh: 锤柄上的骨刺一下立起。
lines.en: The bone spikes on the haft rise.

lines.zh: 它张开嘴，露出腐肉间的牙。
lines.en: It opens its mouth, teeth set in rotten flesh.
It shifts one step and the ground gives.

lines.zh: 它盯着你手里那把小刀。
lines.en: It stares at the little knife in your hand.
My bone armor is breaking, I'm hurt!
My flesh is damaged, it hurts!
My bone hammer is heavy, but I won't fall!

lines.zh: 血肉伤痕累累，挣扎求生！
lines.en: My flesh is scarred, struggling to survive!
My bone armor is broken, the pain is unbearable!
My muscles are injured, movement is sluggish!
Skull Smasher howls, the pain never ends!
Hit, flesh in shambles!
Battled, I'm weak!
Struck, bones and flesh shattered!

lines.zh: 缓慢逼近，骨锤闪烁着寒光。
lines.en: Approach slowly, the bone hammer gleams.

lines.zh: 用骨锤敲击地面，引诱你。
lines.en: Tap the ground with the bone hammer to entice you.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，散发出阴冷气息。
lines.en: Rumble low, exuding coldness.

lines.zh: 厚骨甲下是强壮的肌肉。
lines.en: Strong muscles beneath the thick bones.

lines.zh: 巨大的骨锤是其唯一武器。
lines.en: The huge bone hammer is its only weapon.
Hates groups, acts alone.
My bone hammer swings, slowly.
Attacks when hungry.
Does not drop anything.
Feeds on rotting corpses.
The bone hammer smashes the ground.
The thick bones clash with a sound.
Muscles tense beneath the bone.
Swing the bone hammer, ready for battle.
Slow steps, filled with power.
The bone hammer smashes everything.
The tough bone armor resists.
The massive body crashes into the ground.
The bone hammer smashes the rocks.

lines.zh: 厚骨甲的碰撞声不绝于耳。
lines.en: The sound of the thick bones clashing never ends.
My low rumble sounds like knocking bone.
Tap the ground gently with the bone hammer.
Hisses to find a mate.
Nods to invite a mate.
Gurgles to attract a mate.
Moves slowly, seeking a mate.
Taps the bone hammer gently, showing friendliness.

lines.zh: 发出咕噜咕噜的求偶声。
lines.en: Gurgles a mating call.
Gently taps the bone hammer, mating call.
Rumbles, searching for a mate.

Stares for a long time before approaching
Slowly opens its huge mouth

Thick bone armor blocks vision

lines.zh: 你的气息撞上我的骨甲。
lines.en: Your scent strikes my bone plate.

lines.zh: 我的骨锤就是我的手臂。
lines.en: My bone hammer is my arm.

lines.en: The bone hammer rises; my eye finds you.
Taut muscles filled with intent

Aims at your weak points

Heavy and rapid breathing

Targets your gloves

Targets your hands
Targets your head

Targets your waist

lines.zh: 锤头慢慢举过它的头顶。
lines.en: The hammer head rises above its skull.
It crouches a little and loads its weight.

lines.zh: 它的目光落在你脚站的位置。
lines.en: Its gaze settles where your feet are planted.

lines.zh: 骨甲上的裂痕又绷紧了几分。
lines.en: The cracks in its armor pull taut.

lines.zh: 它把锤头对准地面，准备砸。
lines.en: It points the hammer at the ground to strike.

lines.en: Skull Smasher is born in the abomination!
Abomination summons Skull Smasher!
Darkness brings Skull Smasher!
Skull Smasher, child of abomination!

lines.zh: 憎厌群志的低语召来了它。
lines.en: A hateful chorus whispers it into being.

lines.zh: 腐土隆起，骨甲先露出来。
lines.en: The rot swells and the bone plate surfaces first.

lines.en: The bone hammer is hauled out of the soil.

lines.zh: 召唤圈熄灭，它站了起来。
lines.en: The summoning circle fades and it stands.
